recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. FMG should continue maintaining external maturity/tracking evidence and resolve the pending FMM framework work before final normative publication; reconcile concrete future source wording or fhir.ini changes under the later specific tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-14445 was a Published/Persuasive FMG issue asking FMG to document and communicate that candidate normative artifacts must have FMM 5 evidence in the tracking spreadsheet or FMG dispensation before normative ballot, and must have FMM 5/6 criteria documented before normative publication or be delayed/dropped to STU.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly applying FHIR-14445 was found. The only git history hit for the numeric key was an unrelated legacy SVN revision number. Current source reflects the policy through the Version Management Policy page's FMM definitions and links to FMG-maintained maturity material and maturity metrics.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini is active build configuration and presently contains R6 normative statuses for some artifacts whose FMM values remain below 5. This is acknowledged in source/ballot-intro.html, which tells balloters that all content has been set to Normative or Informative for the R6 normative ballot while FMM status has not been consistently updated pending revisions to the overall FMM framework.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Automatically changing FMM levels, standards status, or adding a stronger publication gate would require FMG/work-group evidence and would be broader than the Jira resolution supports.
